<function name="SetForwardMove" parent="CUserCmd" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets speed the client wishes to move forward with, negative if the clients wants to move backwards.

See also <page>CUserCmd:ClearMovement</page>, <page>CUserCmd:SetSideMove</page> and <page>CUserCmd:SetUpMove</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="speed" type="number">The new speed to request. The client will not be able to move faster than their set walk/sprint speed.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
